scientific_scope: Prospective candidate-class decision after permanent P1-v1, P2-v1, and P3-v1 closure and after the independent P4 evidence gate. This record formally selects only the next broad painted-trail response class for internal development. It does not define an executable P4 mechanism, choose a threshold or smooth/stochastic gate, set sensor geometry, set P4 parameters or bounds, authorize simulation, access the response target, rank candidates, alter canonical locomotion, or unlock reserved Y-maze validation.

prior_closure_boundary.rule: Prior failed models remain scientific closures, not a tuning surface. Their target-ranked outcomes may not choose the P4 equation, threshold, gate form, sensor geometry, field representation, parameters, bounds, RNG, seeds, folds, objective, weights, search budget, or promotion rules.

independent_evidence_input.role: Sole frozen P4 candidate-evidence basis for this decision. It supports one fresh broad class while leaving hard, smooth, stochastic, and regularized implementations unresolved.

selected_next_candidate_class.description: A local painted-trail directional response in which bilateral directional information is preserved, while absolute local pheromone evidence may affect whether or how strongly that directional information is expressed. The class is intentionally broad enough to include prospectively justified detection or gain-modulation forms and is not required to be positively scale-invariant.
selection_rationale: Direct Lasius niger evidence independently shows that stronger pheromone concentration can produce stronger attraction in a controlled concentration series.

Independent trail-following work shows that bilateral relative directional comparison and an absolute detectability stage are mechanistically compatible concepts rather than mutually exclusive alternatives.
A separate Lasius niger trail-strength comparison cautions against assuming one universal smooth dose-response, so the class is selected without choosing hard, smooth, or stochastic expression.
The class is genuinely distinct from P1-v1 because it does not prespecify the old fixed C/(1+C) absolute transduction difference.
The class is genuinely distinct from P2-v1 because any suppression or weakening must depend on sensory evidence rather than a signal-independent trial-level lapse.
The class is genuinely distinct from P3-v1 because it is not constrained to positive scale invariance of a purely normalized left-right response.
The class does not require path-length, travel-direction, recent-food-experience, colony-specific, stable-specialist, or pheromone-driven speed parameters.
selected_next_candidate_class.biological_claim_limit: Selection for internal model development is not a claim that Lasius niger has been shown to use any particular threshold, sigmoid, stochastic detector, regularized ratio, sensor geometry, or mathematical response law.

next_mechanism_freeze_requirements: Choose exactly one mathematical realization of the selected broad class before any P4 implementation or simulation.
Define the absolute-evidence quantity prospectively and justify it without target-ranked outcomes.
Define behavior at exactly zero and near-zero bilateral concentration, including any threshold, smooth gate, or stochastic-detection boundary if selected.
Freeze sensor geometry and field treatment before runtime implementation.
Preserve canonical speed, pauses, angular-noise amplitude, contacts, locomotion state, and biology RNG unless a separate independent gate explicitly changes them.
Define exact canonical/nested null identities and require bit-for-bit canonical identity at zero applied pheromone.
Freeze rotation, translation, endpoint-reversal, reflection/local-steering-sign, no-along-trail-preference, and zero-signal invariances.
Freeze one engineering-only reference-free reachability panel and all seeds before execution; do not tune it after observing outcome.
Keep response-target semantics, target-ranked candidate search, and reserved project Y-maze validation locked until later explicit authorization gates.
